summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a preliminary pricing supplement (424B5) for a public offering of $ senior fixed-rate 10-year callable notes due July 17, 2036. The notes carry a 6.00% interest rate, payable semi-annually, with an issue price of 100% ($1,000 per note). The issuer has the right to redeem the notes in whole or in part on Optional Redemption Dates starting July 17, 2028. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The offering is conducted through Jefferies LLC, the issuer's wholly-owned broker-dealer subsidiary, creating a FINRA Rule 5121 conflict of interest. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation.
